lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters distributed across the mid-lateral flank, with higher density and larger diameters observed in the posterior-ventral region relative to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and a shadow-induced low-luminance zone on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal organisms (Echeneidae) are visible in close proximity to the posterior and ventral margins of the left pectoral fin.
